scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec db psql -U gatewasm -d gatewasm -c 'DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;'
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.clean:npm: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json admin/node_modules admin/package-lock.json && npm cache clean --force
scripts.fresh: npm run clean:npm && npm install && cd admin && npm install && cd .. && npm run build:ssr
